fields.System.Title: INT-302 — Order status view
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer service agent, I want order progress answered from one row, so that the
query stays fast as order history grows.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the projection from
  • [OUT-701](../OUT/OUT-701-maintain-order-status-view.md), then it is exposed for internal
  • and integration use.
  • - Given the view, then it is updated asynchronously from order events.
  • - Given the response, then it exposes last_updated_at.
  • - Given an order that changed seconds ago, then the view may lag — and that is documented
  • as acceptable for this question.
  • - Given the view, then it never joins the transactional tables at read time.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, outbound |
| Tables | order_status |
| Risks | Staleness invisible to the reader ([doc 08 §5.3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
